特别注意：RGBA 模式不适用于所有节点，您将需要 RGB。 RGBA 适用于我正在做的事情，但它适用于很多节点，但最好使用 RGB 模式。

Animated Flux Scnhell：好吧......忘记旧的工作流程。这是我将维护和更新的一个。对于我对我的项目缺乏关心和关注，我深表歉意。我处于学习和实验模式。我想知道一切是如何运作的。喜欢这一切。至少在视频和图像编辑方面，语言模型中的层是如何工作的，在图像处理和编辑中，在2D细胞动画中，在电影中，声音是如何工作的，一切如何用光、阴影和频率相互叠加。基本上，我学到了很多我认为自己已经了解很多的事情，但我大错特错了。

请将此视为我作品的序言，并感谢您的耐心和理解。

我将详细说明，但这是实验性的并且正在进行中。我将在更新节点时更新此工作流程，以便您可以根据需要看到它的进度。如果你想要一个更稳定的节点，我完全理解。在这个阶段，这变得有点复杂，现在已经能够做很多事情，但还处于早期阶段。当我修复一些问题时，还有更多内容需要合并。

并非所有动画或滤镜都能正常工作或按预期工作。移动需要您设置起点和终点。弹跳也有效。矩阵似乎只能工作，直到您看到我的另一个节点（矩阵过滤器）实际上应该做什么。它利用 Flux 来获得清晰的主题，用作 2D 动画，与 AnimateDiff 一起用作 int 视频，以资源密集程度较低的方式制作 AI 视频。动画使用视频编辑、图像编辑、2D 动画的原理。和各种字段来创建一个简化的动画师，可用于制作更详细的视频。

请检查 githun 以获取详细说明。我概述了开发人员部分和用户部分。克劳德的帮助很大。尤其是我不擅长的文档。我什至把它的笔记留在那里，因为我需要它们。

首次更新 ComfyUI

接下来，您必须更改 ComfyUI 管理器 confing.ini 并更改安全性，以允许您安装基本上您只需要的位和字节等 - 在正常结束时。它应该已经设置为正常，所以只需将其更改为“正常-”

接下来，比特和字节问题

https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI_bitsandbytes_NF4?tab=readme-ov-file

安装后可能会出现错误，您需要使用 comfyUI 管理器 pip install 功能并输入 -u bitsandbytes

这可以解决您可能遇到的这个特定问题。

Special Note: RGBA mode will not work with all nodes, you will need RGB. RGBA is for something I'm doing, but it will work with a lot of nodes, but you are better off using RGB mode.

Animated Flux Scnhell: Okay... forget the old workflows. This is the one I will be maintaining and updating. I apologize for my lack of care and attention to my projects. I was in a learning and experimentational mode. I wanted to know how everything worked. Like all of it. At least in relation to video and image editing, how the layers in the language models worked, in image manipulation and editing, in 2D cell animation, in Movies, how sound worked, how everything layered on top of each other with lights and shadows and frequencies. Basically, I learned a lot about things I thought I already knew a lot about and was woefully mistaken.

Please consider this the prologue to my opus, and thank you for your patience and understanding.

I will elaborate more, but this is experimental and a work in progress. I will update this workflow as I update the node so you can see it's progress if you would like. If you would rather a more stable node, I completely understand. This is becoming a bit complex at this stage and capable of many things now already and it's only in early stages still. There's more to incorporate as I fix some things.

Not all animations or filters work or work as intended. Move requires you to set start and end point. Bounce also works. Matrix only seems to work until you see what's actually supposed to do with my other node the matrix filter. This utilizes flux to gain sharp subjects to use as 2D animations to use with AnimateDiff as int videos to make, well AI video in a less resource intensive way. The animations use principles from video editing, image editing, 2D animation. and various fields to create a simplified animator that can be used to make more detailed videos.

Please check the githun for a detailed explanation. I have outlined a section for Developers and a Section for users. Claude has helped significantly. Especially with the documentation which I am terrible at. I even left it's notes for me in there, because I will need them.

First Update ComfyUI

Next you gotta change your ComfyUI manager confing.ini and change the security to allow you to install bitsandbytes and etc. essentially you just need - at the end of normal. It should already be set to normal so just change it to "normal-"

Next, Bits and Bytes issue

https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI_bitsandbytes_NF4?tab=readme-ov-file

After installing this it may give you an error, you'll need to use the comfyUI manager pip install function and enter -u bitsandbytes

This resolves this particular issue you may encounter.
